biography.plain_text: Merle Wood is an American yacht broker who founded Merle Wood & Associates in Fort Lauderdale. Raised in a brokerage family, he built his own firm around international sales, purchase advice and new construction. His business represents buyers and sellers, earning fees by arranging transactions rather than building the vessels itself.

long_biography.plain_text:
Yacht broker Merle Wood learned to look beyond the purchase price when advising clients. Two early customers impressed on him the importance of quality and eventual resale value. He wanted buyers to remain satisfied enough to return when selling or replacing a boat, and to introduce friends to the firm.

That approach required a team serving different parts of the market. In 2019, his company opened a Bahia Mar office for its Production and Custom Division, covering established builders including Azimut, Ferretti, Sunseeker and Hatteras. Wood announced the expansion as a way to recruit additional experienced brokers while keeping the firm's existing Fort Lauderdale headquarters.
